summary: Cloud accounting software for invoicing, expenses, payments, payroll and bookkeeping for small businesses.
access_note: Free Intuit developer account, create an app, get Client ID/secret; sandbox companies for testing.
blocker_note: Production keys for other users' companies are expected to require Intuit app assessment/listing; not confirmed from a page read.

evidence.quote: Use the OAuth 2.0 protocol to implement authentication and authorization.
Start by signing in to your developer account and creating an app on the Intuit Developer Portal.
Use access tokens to call specific APIs and interact with users' QuickBooks Online company data.
This server uses OAuth 2.0 to authenticate to a QuickBooks Online company.

notes: Intuit docs are JavaScript-rendered; read via a browser. REST and GraphQL are inferred from SDK/OAuth text and the nav entry 'Develop with GraphQL' (no sentence read). Access tokens last one hour, refresh tokens 100 days (rolling, value rotates). The MCP is Intuit's open-source local server (early preview); a remote endpoint appears in third-party directories only. App-review blocker is from general knowledge, not a page read.
